app_store.name: QuoteLite
app_store.subtitle: Quote, invoice, get paid
app_store.promotional_text: Write the quote in the driveway. It still saves if the signal drops. One flat monthly price.
app_store.description:
QuoteLite is for a one to three person trade crew.

Open a quote, add the lines, and send a link by text. The customer approves without making an account. You turn that quote into an invoice in one tap and record the payment.

What you get:
- Quotes with photos, tax, and notes
- A link the customer can open
- Invoices, partial payments, and a paid balance
- The same loop with no signal, then a sync
- Your own card account, with no cut taken by us
- Solo at $19 a month or Crew at $29

People on the crew are not an extra charge.
app_store.whats_new: Quotes, invoices, and payments on the phone, including with no signal.

google_play.full_description:
QuoteLite is for a one to three person trade crew.

Open a quote, add the lines, and send a link by text. The customer approves without making an account. You turn that quote into an invoice in one tap and record the payment.

Quotes, photos, tax, partial payments, and a paid balance. The loop works with no signal and syncs when you are back. Card payments go through your own account.

Solo is $19 a month. Crew is $29. People on the crew are not an extra charge.
